items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: So I don't blame Billie Holliday one bit.

ctx.x: sorts of arrangers, arranging his music, you know, and he had one guy, an arranger, came up to -- it was a rehearsal at Connie's Inn, and this arranger had written some notes on my part, you know, and he probably wanted me to play clarinet like Ted Lewis or somebody, but he said to me, "Well, can't you growl on it?" I said, "What do you mean, growl?" I said, "No, I can't growl on no clarinet." I probably could have done it, but I just wouldn't do it because he thought that that's what -- because you were a black…
So I don't blame Billie Holliday one bit.
So, anything else before we leave Fletcher Henderson?
